direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just had her phone returned. Her attention turns to Kasun's small food three-wheeler.
direction.people: Anudi stands frame left, facing right, in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt. She holds her phone low in her right hand, an open umbrella in her left, and a handbag on her left forearm. She feels grateful and curious. Kasun is off screen.

flow.text: Anudi holds a small smile, her phone resting at her right waist. She looks toward the food three-wheeler, then back toward Kasun.

flow.how: Warm, friendly curiosity to learn about his work, lifting her chin slightly toward him

flow.text: She keeps her gaze on Kasun, her smile lingering as she waits.

direction.camera: Eye-level medium single from the road side on a 50mm lens, with the vehicle edge in the right background, in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
